answer: During each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and registers a Semaphore identity in the RLN tree, then evaluates an epoch polynomial whose committed shares authenticate rate-limited messages. Two messages in the same interval produce distinct Shamir points; interpolation exposes the agent’s private key, enabling permissionless proof verification and instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus, sybil identities are costly, whether hidden in a dune, a walnut, or a whisper.
